page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Above the text: page number 172 at left, running head "PETRUS à VALLE" at right, with a rule beneath. Catchword "nec" at lower right, below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: instar pictoris absque ulla intelligentia delineare poterat, si transumptum fieret, parum feliciter res eveniret, libenter etiam in hanc sententiam descendi, ut ipsummet originale ad te mitteram; hoc demum promisi me facturum Domino de Peiresc, cui de hac re jampridem scripsi, sed ob exortas, ut puto, belli & pestis, in suis regionibus turbulentias, nihil ad-respondit: hoc idem R. Patri Bertino, & tibi ipsi, quem ob egregia merita tua mirifice colo, nunc denuo promitto. Ve-rum enim vero, quemadmodum & Patri Bertino, & Domino de Peiresc significavi, tria in hoc negotio desidero, quae ab humanitate tua certo scio non fore mihi deneganda; primum quidem, ut librum ad te quam tutissime mittere possim, cum enim nullum aliud exemplar, quam istud Pentateuchi Samaritani in Europa habe-amus, & ex Asia adducere difficillimum sit, ne dicam fere impossibile, illud in i-tinere alicui periculo objicere, impu-dentis[?] esset; alterum quod cupio, est ut codex iste meus diligenter adseruetur

page.notes: Long s is read as s throughout. "qve" in "absque" and "quae" is read as the vowel u (qu). The word "impu-dentis" is printed with the hyphen after "impu" and the rest is partly obscured; the reading "imprudentis" is likely but not certain. "Asia" and "adseruetur" are clear but the page is slightly soft. The running head is in small capitals. The catchword "nec" stands at lower right.
